name: Car Salesman Slaps Roof Of Car
aka: This Bad Boy Can Fit So Much
look: A clean, simple illustration of a smiling car salesman in a black suit and tie showing off a silver car with an open-handed gesture. A customer in a white shirt stands beside him with a hand raised to his chin, thinking it over. Plain white background.
use: A sales pitch for anything. The top caption reads like *slaps roof of* the thing being sold, and the bottom brags that this bad boy can fit so much of something absurd in it.
slots: *slaps roof of* the thing being sold (top)
this bad boy can fit so much ___ in it (bottom)
examples: This bad boy can fit so many screenshots I'll never look at again
This bad boy can fit so many leftovers nobody will eat
describe: salesman hitting the top of a car
cartoon salesman in a suit showing a car to a customer
guy in a suit selling a car saying it can fit so much
